EventItemActionText: The Rules, Confirmations, and Public Elections Committee recommended the nominees. The President called for an election to fill one vacancy on the Health and Educational Facilities Board. Nominations previously made were Chase Markham and Will Rosenthal. The following vote was taken on the nominated candidates: Will Rosenthal (27): Suara, Allen, Hill, Kimbrough, Gamble, Cortese, Benedict, Webb, Eslick, Evans, Bradford, Huffman, Welsch, Vo, Cash, Kupin, Taylor, Druffel, Johnston, Nash, Benton, Ellis, Rutherford, Styles, Lee, Ewing, and Spain; Chase Markham (7): Evans-Segall, Parker, Capp, Harrell, Horton, Preptit, and Sepulveda; Abstain (0). The president declared that Will Rosenthal was elected to the Board.
